faces.said.foldShown: {name} is shown as the row's text, note or mark, so it cannot also unfold
faces.said.headerNotOne: {name} is not a field of one value, so it cannot be shown in the head
faces.said.listNotShapes: {name} is not an array of an entity's or a value's elements, so it cannot give the rows
faces.said.markFieldNeeded: mark needs field (the enum or bool field that decides the mark)
faces.said.markNotEnum: {name} is not a field of one enum value or bool, so it cannot decide a mark
faces.said.markShape: mark is an object {field, values, none}
faces.said.noField: This shape has no field "{name}" (its top-level fields: {names})
faces.said.notNames: Write a list of field names
faces.said.notObject: face is an object ({list, header} or {text, note, mark, fold}; null removes it)
faces.said.notRole: {role} is not a role of a mark ({roles})
faces.said.notText: {name} is not a field of one text (string, text) or enum value, so it cannot be a row's text
faces.said.notValue: {value} is not a value of the field ({values})
faces.said.valuesShape: mark's values is an object {value: role}
